# BUILD PHASE 23: Remove Input and event dispatch dependence on BaseApp

## Phase Identity

- Track: Build System Migration; phase 23; status: NOT STARTED.

- Branch: build/cmake-conan-migration; source: render-refactor-phase-00-approved.

## Goal

Invert application service lookups in InputManager/EventManager/window coordination.

## Why This Phase Exists

InputManager.cpp and EventManager.cpp call BaseApp::GetEngine/GetWindowManager, feeding high-level composition back into low-level services.

## Preconditions

Phase 22 is fully approved/published; HEAD equals build-phase-22-approved peeled commit; explicit START BUILD PHASE 23.
No other active phase or pending approval transaction. Load AGENTS, execution skill,
BUILD_STATE and this contract first. Verify status/index, remote, tag and protected
work; freeze exact ownership before changes. Read only relevant audit/code-map/source
sections and record concrete reasons for context expansion. REVISE applies only to
this active phase and invalidates its prior seal before edits.

## Allowed Scope

InputManager/EventManager/WindowManager interfaces and implementations; exact BaseApp/GEngine setup and call sites; small event/input service adapters.
This phase's review/evidence and local state/receipts may be updated. Scope families
must be expanded into exact paths before editing; they are not staging wildcards.

## Explicit Non-Goals

No other phase, next-phase implementation, unlisted production change, general
Rendering/Physics refactor, C++23 modernization, commit, tag or push during execution.
No input remapping, callback reordering, extra event framework or general dependency-injection infrastructure. Preserve window/controller ownership.

Pass existing service references or narrow callbacks during composition; keep EventManager routing in Application and neutral events below Platform/Input.
Produce one understandable diff and `../reviews/BUILD_PHASE_23_REVIEW.md` with

Keep applicable Premake/runtime protections and unrelated work intact. Local state,
